# Michelle Galoob — Intuitive Consultant

> Michelle Galoob is a channel, intuitive guide and Akashic Records reader. She offers one-on-one Akashic Records readings by phone and teaches people to trust their own intuition through the Intuition Mastery Program. Certified through the James Van Praagh School of Mystical Arts (JVP Mediumship Level I Certification Course; Certified Psychic Intuitive Messenger).

Key facts:
- Services: phone readings — 30 min ($200), 45 min ($285), 1 hour ($375), package of 2 one-hour sessions ($660), package of 4 one-hour sessions ($1,280).
- Who it helps: people who feel blocked, are at a crossroads, want to connect with their soul's purpose, or have questions about personal or business relationships.
- Approach: grounded and practical ("No airy fairy here!"); trained for 10 months in the Akashic Records with a renowned healer from Argentina.
- Contact: +1 424-777-3672 · michellegaloob@gmail.com · Instagram @michellegaloob
- Training/courses: https://michellegaloobtraining.com/ (free Intuition Activation Starter Kit; Intuition Mastery Program)
